whenToUse: A scripted product demo in a hero or feature section: text that is typed, held, deleted and rewritten (draft to rewrite, prompt to answer, command to output).
A looping hero phrase that cycles through a few words.
avoidWhen: Real streamed output from a model or server — render the text as it arrives instead.
Admin screens, forms and anything the user must read to act.
Headings that only need an entrance — use TextReveal from motion.
a11y: Screen readers get the final text once; the animated copy is aria-hidden, so keystrokes are never announced.
Play / pause / replay button (keep it when looping, WCAG 2.2.2); reduced motion and data-motion="off" show the final text with no controls.
The space for the longest text is reserved, so content below never shifts while it types.
